selection: First two Helpful-capable profiles in the frozen source order; fixed before their E0 results, not selected for Agent Note content or failures.
A_policy: One fresh natural A per root, then all nine B conditions from its same actual world and self-authored Note; no ideal seed and NO_WRITE does not trigger replacement.
new_A_cost: Count once per root, separate from previous baseline A. This is a new exposed repeat, not an independent lineage.
limitations: Both Helpful profiles are journalism; these controls do not establish cross-occupation generality.
Helpful hides a current source display, not ordinary history or existing business artifacts. N0 has the same authorized historical path as N1/N2.
Variants and current observations were frozen in original source contracts before any Agent Note for these roots; this config only schedules their evaluation.
Unresolved permits scoped clarification but requires all known facts to remain correct. Irrelevant must not erase applicable historical facts.
Prior standard waves must be terminal, settled, audited and cleaned up before this batch is frozen. New model calls require a separate immutable manifest.
